items.title: RedHawks Close Regular Season With Trip to WMU
items.summary: The Miami University football team plays its final regular season contest of 2026 on the road at Western Michigan on Tuesday, Nov. 24. Opening kick is slated for 7 p.m. and will be carried live on ESPN2.

items.title: Football Holds Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: Miami University head football coach Chuck Martin, along with offensive lineman Kris Manu, spoke with the local media on Thursday morning as the RedHawks prepare to face Western Michigan on Tuesday, Nov. 24.

items.title: RedHawks Run Past Kent State, 20-3

items.title: Tretter, Jones Named Skyline Athletes of the Week
items.summary: For their performances last week, Amber Tretter and D'Shawntae Jones are Miami's Athletes of the Week, presented by Skyline Chili for the week of November 16.

items.title: RedHawks Travel to Face Kent State Tuesday Night
items.summary: The Miami University football team plays at Kent State on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The contest is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. on ESPNU.

items.title: 'Crazy, Crazy, Crazy': Miami's 34-Point Outburst Stuns Ohio
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio— Every win in the Battle of the Bricks is memorable.   But some are especially memorable.   And Tuesday's 34-17 Miami victory in the 103rd edition of this historic rivalry was one for the record books.   The RedHawks overcame a 17-0 second-quarter deficit and ripped off 34 straight points to shock Ohio and hand the Bobcats their first conference loss of the season.

items.title: RedHawks Host Ohio on Senior Night
items.summary: The Miami University football team hosts the Ohio Bobcats on Tuesday, Nov. 10 inside Yager Stadium on ESPN2. Miami will also honor several seniors prior to the 8 p.m. start in the annual "Battle of the Bricks."
